newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Bobst H1 sales up, outlook positive.
newsitem.headline: Bobst H1 sales up, outlook positive.

text.p: Swiss packaging machinery group Bobst SA said on Tuesday consolidated turnover rose to 590 million Swiss francs in the first half of 1997 from 524 million in the same 1996 period.
The company said in a statement the increase was higher than forecast, and that it expected the trend to continue.
"In the prevailing economic situation, Group Management expects an increase in the turnover of the fiscal year 1997, in keeping with the trend during the first six months," it said.
Bobst expected profit to increase by more than 20 percent this year, thanks in part to the fact that it will not incur restructuring charges as was the case in 1996.
Favourable exchange rates contributed nearly half of the 12.5 percent increase in turnover in the first half.
Order intake and order backlog were also higher in first half. The improvements were seen in all main markets, including Western Europe, despite weakness in some countries' economies in the region.
It said that during the second quarter of 1997, it acquired all remaining shares in Asitrade SA in Grenchen, Switzerland, in which it already owned 76 percent.
It also said it is opening its own sales and service organisation in Mexico City to serve Central America and Northern Latin America.
The company has completed construction of a new plant in Shanghai.
